0022600215.text: The Kings (1-9, 0-5 at home, on a three-game losing streak and 14th in the West) host the Orlando Magic (2-7, 0-4 at home, on a four-game losing streak and 12th in the East) in Sacramento's 11th game of the 2026-27 season. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and Domantas Sabonis (knee soreness) and Keegan Murray (wrist soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), with Tristan da Silva (calf strain) day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Kings lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 121-117 in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
